reader_notes: Clean, confident opinion-piece Swedish; the title, the concession paragraph ('Det ligger något i det') and the closing line all fit the genre.

Q1 rewards a reader who kept the scope conditions (effect only beyond three days, clearest in flerbostadshus, small in villaområden) - options C and D each invert one of those conditions, which is a good use of the qualifying sentence.
Q2 option C is the natural overshoot ('förråden blir onödiga') and is directly refuted by 'En överenskommelse vid köksbordet ersätter aldrig ett förråd'.
Both items are answerable strictly from the text with no outside knowledge about Swedish krisberedskap campaigns.
